flag_meaning.no_page: the row has no Wikipedia page (`wiki`)
flag_meaning.no_latin: a taxon without a Latin name
flag_meaning.name_breaks_rule: the page title is a common name (brackets dropped), the row name differs from it and the web name check did not find the name already right: a rename, or a more specific concept that needs its own row (docs/NODE-NAMES.md steps 1 and 4)
flag_meaning.name_unchecked: the page title is only a Latin name, so the right name is the Wikidata label (step 2): jobs/rowtitles.py checks it on the web, the offline audit cannot. Listed: a row the web check has not seen, and a row it found a better name for that no other row has yet. Not listed: a row whose name is already right, a row whose proposed name another row already holds or wants too (the scientific name stays), and a row where the check found only another article (a genus, a split species) and no plain rename
flag_meaning.shared_page: another row of the same kind has the same page
flag_meaning.shared_name: another row of the same kind has the same name
flag_meaning.shared_latin: another taxon row has the same Latin name
flag_meaning.no_node: no place node uses the row
flag_meaning.no_about: a taxon or group without a description (`about`)
